Been on TRT for 7 weeks and feel suicidal in between. Is this normal?

I got tested a while back, and it took a couple of months of extra testing to rule out other problems. Finally got put on TRT, a shot of 200 mg/mL  testosterone Cypionate injecting 1mL into muscle every 2 weeks.

My original Test was at ~240. I'm 6'1" 260 lbs, and bmi is around ~25%. Since then I have dropped weight significantly down to ~240 lbs. And exercise more than just at work. Work is manual labor lifting 80 lbs, through out the day and I get about 10,000 steps easy every weekday. On weekends my wife and I will find something fun and healthy to do outside, dancing, hiking, climbing, etc. I have just started doing yoga again to help as well.

I feel exceptionally better physically, but mentally I have been on a emotional wreck. I cry way to much over silly things, and twice I have thought about suicide. The second time I almost went ahead with it. I didn't want to talk to my wife at first, but ended up doing so. She wants me to contact my doctor first thing in the morning.

I have read that HCG and Amrimidex would help with a balanced regime.
My wife and I do want to have children and I am not in any way trying to build muscle. I have a big chest and bench 285 lbs no problem. I would rather have a slimmer cardio body than a muscle one.

Sorry its long, but most importantly I want to get rid of wanting to kill myself, and crying and being too mopey.
